findings.text: A global capability query reports whether a confidential computing attribute is active. It selects an AMD helper or an Intel helper according to current vendor state, and reports absent for any other vendor.

Two address value transforms provide encrypted and decrypted variants. Each consults vendor and virtual top of memory state to either set or clear a shared mask bit, leaving input unchanged when no known vendor applies.
A pair of mutators clears or sets platform capability state. Only the AMD path performs an update and only for the host SNP attribute, while all other vendors and attributes leave state untouched.
An encrypted IO mapping helper requests a write back mapping with encryption demanded, delegating to a common caller tracking mapping routine.
Page table inspection helpers resolve a virtual address to the table entry that maps it, reporting paging level and accumulated access attributes while walking from the top level toward the leaf.
Random helpers expose hardware random long retrieval with retry and a bounded multi long variant that only succeeds when the CPU feature is enabled and a single retrieval succeeds.
A probe registration interface installs a memory mapped IO probe for a range, failing when a probe already covers the aligned base or when address lookup yields no entry.
Intel helper returns true for CC_ATTR_GUEST_UNROLL_STRING_IO and also for CC_ATTR_GUEST_MEM_ENCRYPT and also for CC_ATTR_MEM_ENCRYPT, and false otherwise.
When virtual top of memory mode is indicated, AMD delegates capability queries to a reduced helper that only affirms guest memory encryption and also memory encryption.

For AMD without virtual top of memory, memory encryption follows the SME mask, host memory encryption needs that mask without SEV enabled, guest memory encryption needs SEV enabled, guest state encryption needs SEV ES enabled, SNP and secure TSC and secure AVIC each follow their own status indication, and host SNP follows a software flag.
AMD requests unrolled string IO only when SEV is enabled without SEV ES, reflecting that ES handles those instructions through its exception path.

Encryption marking sets the mask for AMD classic mode but clears it for AMD virtual top of memory mode and also for Intel, while decryption does the opposite, with identity behavior without a known vendor.

Early random seeding runs only when guest memory encryption is present, repeatedly requesting longs until a fixed seed buffer is full, aborting the system when no progress is possible, then mixing the buffer into device randomness and erasing it.

Common IO remap rejects zero size and wrap around and invalid physical addresses and system RAM, aligns to page boundaries, strips non address bits, reserves memtype, reconciles cache mode, and unwinds reservation or area on failure.

Resulting protection starts from a kernel IO default and becomes encrypted when collected flags or explicit demand indicate encryption, otherwise decrypted, with cache mode bits layered on except for write back which adds nothing.

A memtype compatibility check always allows untracked platform ranges but forbids promotion to write back from uncached minus or write combine or write through, and also forbids promotion to write combine from write through.

Address lookup descends through four levels, updating level identity and folding no execute and writability at each step, stopping with the current table pointer when an entry is empty or represents a leaf or is not present.

PMD helpers derive flag versus frame portions by masking, treat present as any of present or protection none or page size extension, treat leaf as page size extension, and treat empty as zero low word ignoring a kernel erratum mask.
Additional encryption marking is skipped without guest memory encryption, otherwise private MMIO forces encryption, and selected EFI data types with runtime association also force encryption.
SNP startup locates the application processor jump address by mapping the secrets page as encrypted, reading the OS area field, unmapping, and returning zero with an error log when mapping fails.

MMIO trace installation holds a dedicated trace lock while revalidating enablement and linking the new trace before registering its probe, and probe registration holds interrupt save plus a dedicated fault lock while checking duplicates and arming fault pages.
A compact flag container holds a single host SNP bit plus reserved space to fill sixty four bits, instantiated once as global mutable state.

SEV state includes global read only after init scalars for hypervisor features and secrets location and TSC scale and offset and frequency and privilege level and communication block version, plus per CPU pointers to runtime data and to save areas.
Vendor selection starts at none, directing capability queries and transforms and flag updates into AMD or Intel behavior or into neutral absent or identity or no operation responses.
Hardware random retrieval attempts the instruction repeatedly up to a fixed retry count, succeeding early on carry indication and failing only after exhausting retries.
Paging level advances from largest to smallest coverage as descent succeeds, with size and shift and mask derived arithmetically from level identity.
An init time seeding routine and an init time SNP jump lookup run during early boot, while capability queries are marked to avoid instrumentation for safe use in sensitive contexts.

Hazards include system abort when hardware randomness yields no longs in a confidential guest, null returns for invalid or RAM or exhausted mappings, one time warnings for RAM remap and multi BAR coverage, and duplicate probe or missing table entry failures during probe install.

Bringup defaults set CS limit and also DS limit and also LDTR limit and also GDTR limit and also IDTR limit and also TR limit each to 0xffff, RFLAGS to 0x2, DR6 to 0xffff0ff0, and extended control to 0x1.
Further bringup defaults set page attribute table to 0x0007040600070406, x87 tag word to 0x5555, x87 control to 0x0040, control register zero to 0x60000010, and MXCSR to 0x1f80.

Status bit positions map to short labels for SEV and also SEV-ES and also SEV-SNP and also vTom and also ReflectVC and also RI and also AI and also DebugSwap and also NoHostIBS and also BTBIsol and also VmplSSS and also SecureTSC and also VMGExitParam and also IBSVirt and also VMSARegProt and also SMTProt and also SecureAVIC and also IBPBOnEntry.

Memory set exists as a builtin macro, a visible wrapper delegating to an internal helper that chooses constant count or generic paths, and a 64 bit assembly form that diverts on a fast string feature before repeating store bytes.

Feature test returns zero without querying when the queried bit is compile time disabled, otherwise consulting static CPU capability state, while a one time warning helper evaluates its condition once and emits a tainted warning only on first true.
MMIO mapping trace first checks a global atomic enable flag, logs the mapping, honors an optional physical filter, and only then allocates and links trace state.

Fault page arming reuses an existing entry by incrementing its reference count and arming only when transitioning from zero, otherwise allocating and initializing a count of one before arming and linking into a hashed bucket.
Level size is two raised to a shift that starts from page shift and steps by entry shift per level, with mask as negation of size minus one.
